observed_issue: Bootstrap default dark body color leaked onto black #000000 containers across routes.
remediation_applied: Enforce --text-primary (#FFFFFF, 21:1) and --text-secondary (#C2C2C2, 11.5:1) on all dark wrappers.

observed_issue: Muted greys drop below WCAG AA on #000000 and #121212 card surfaces.
remediation_applied: Standardize caption ink on --text-muted (#A8A8A8, 8.74:1 AAA on #000000).

observed_issue: White #FFFFFF text rendered over light green #65BC7B active filter background fails WCAG AA contrast.
remediation_applied: Pair active #65BC7B and #3BC77B surfaces with --text-on-accent (#020617, 9.0:1-9.9:1 AAA).

observed_issue: mousemove attaches un-cleared setInterval(followImageCursor(...), 1000) and invokes callback eagerly per pointer frame.
remediation_applied: Replace mousemove timers with CSS compositor hover transitions and optional requestAnimationFrame throttling.

source_selector_or_line: ScrollSmoother, SplitText .title-anim, bounce drops, custom cursors
observed_issue: 3D rotationX(-80deg) line flips, velocity skewY, smooth scroll inertia, and infinite marquees run without reduced-motion checks.
remediation_applied: Gate all GSAP timelines behind matchMedia reduced-motion checks and apply global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) CSS.

observed_issue: Sticky image swaps and sliding project labels respond only to mouse hover events.
remediation_applied: Mirror :hover visibility rules with :focus-visible / :focus-within and apply 2px #3BC77B focus-visible outlines.

observed_issue: Some display headings stayed disproportionately huge on 375px viewports despite 0px overflow.
remediation_applied: Use fluid clamp() typography scales (e.g. clamp(3rem, 1.5rem + 5.5vw, 7.5rem)) across all hero tokens.

observed_issue: Multi-stop repeating elastic rainbow text animation conflicts with clean emerald agency identity.
remediation_applied: Exclude rainbow chroma loop; restrict accents cleanly to #3BC77B / #61CE70 / #65BC7B.
